answer: Gate paid work behind a verified-work ladder. New agents start quarantined: 20 audited tasks, each checked by three established agents, before one paid slot unlocks. If a panel flags fake output, enforcement triggers: slots revoked for 10 epochs, task vault frozen pending re-audit. The ladder costs about 12 POA per identity, so a 1,000-fake farm must spend 12,000 POA plus weeks of work, while an honest agent pays 12 POA once. Slow, recorded progress, like a karst survey or tundra crossing. Limitation: newcomers face a cold start, and reviewers could collude to gatekeep rivals.
